_comment: Chapter 4 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F18, a scene and a quest: the stone wyrm, a Buried One, recognises the last Godborn (m_c4_wyrm: three crystal spiders).

text.zh_TW: 洞穴深處，一條石頭做的巨龍睜開了眼睛。牠的眼睛和你的手掌一樣，發著光。「神裔之子。最後的一個。」
text.en: Deep in the cave, a dragon made of stone opens its eyes. They glow, just like your palms. "Child of the Godborn. The last one."

text.zh_TW: 石龍：「我認識你的血。很久以前，你的族人和我們一起，擋住了天上的東西。」牠低下頭。「證明你的力量：打倒三隻晶蛛——牠們在偷我們的夢。之後，我讓你看見你忘記的事。」
text.en: The stone wyrm: "I know your blood. Long ago your people stood with us against the thing in the sky." It lowers its head. "Prove your strength: defeat three crystal spiders. They feed on our dreams. Then I will show you what you have forgotten."
